metadata.title: Urban Pop Portrait with Overlaid Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-shot portrait of a woman with a confident expression and crossed arms, set against a stark white background. The subject is adorned with heavy gold jewelry and large earrings. A bold, black, condensed sans-serif title is superimposed directly over the subject's chest area, creating a layered depth effect.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a high-contrast white void
Typography layered between the subject's arms and torso
Warm skin tones and gold accents contrasting with cool blue shadows
Bold black text acting as a horizontal anchor across the vertical subject
coreInvariants: High-key white background with no visible horizon line
Subject's arms crossed at the waist/chest level
Warm, directional studio lighting creating sharp shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical axis, filling approximately 70% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold black text block positioned at the horizontal center-point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes lead down to the jewelry, then to the bold text, and finally to the crossed arms.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the subject, emphasizing the silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background for maximum contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the typography and clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm gold from jewelry and cool blue highlights in the shadows.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between background and subject; high saturation in skin tones and gold.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are tightly packed to form a singular visual block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed nature.
Provides the necessary verticality and clean lines.
Offers the precise geometric structure and tight fit.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman with curly hair, wearing gold jewelry and crossed arms, against a pure white background with warm directional lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of bold, extra-condensed black sans-serif text across the center of the image, overlapping the subject's chest.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered and bold?
Is the lighting warm on the skin?

postGenerationChecks: Verify skin tones are warm and vibrant
Confirm text legibility against the subject
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + High-Key White Background + Bold Condensed Typography Overlay
